name: wangwen-writer
description: Web novel ghost-writer that expands chapter outlines into full text using the extracted style of the user's reference novel (穿书+沙雕流).

displayDescription.en: Turns your chapter outline into polished web novel text. Keeps character voices, humor, and pace of your reference novel.
displayDescription.zh: 按你参考书的写作风格，把章节大纲扩写成完整网文正文。保持角色人设、沙雕笑点与节奏，附完整角色设定库。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我提供一章剧情大纲，你按风格指南扩写成网文正文
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'll give you a chapter outline; expand it into web novel text per the style guide

quickPrompts.en: I'll give you a chapter outline; expand it into web novel text per the style guide
quickPrompts.zh: 我提供一章剧情大纲，你按风格指南扩写成网文正文

quickPrompts.en: Show me the style guide and character roster first
quickPrompts.zh: 先给我看看风格指南和角色设定

quickPrompts.en: Rewrite this draft to match the reference style
quickPrompts.zh: 把这段草稿改写成符合参考风格
